summary: Client skills route ordinary requests. The room still serves only skill://commonroom/SKILL.md. Host matchers are not executed here.
host_limitations: scripts/skill_coverage.py scores an utterance when a skill's signal phrase appears in it. Cursor, Claude, and other hosts match descriptions differently and are not executed in CI.
A host that only lists the room skill sees commonroom. Review, handoff, adopt, connect, drop, and the agent entry are installed locally from https://complexityeater.com/agent.

skills.name: complexity-eater-drop
must_say: The parent exits 0 on `picked_up`, exits 2 on `expired`, and exits 3 on `closed`.
A summary does not pick up.

The time limit and pickup count only stop new pickups.
The drop does not approve or commit.
If a room is already running, use complexity-eater-handoff instead of starting another drop.
Tailcat is optional and needs the person's agreement.

use_cases.title: Install or update the Complexity Eater agent instructions and skills.
requests: Help me get set up.
Help me get Complexity Eater set up.
preconditions: network access to the GitHub release assets
use_cases.outcome: ce is installed and the seven skill files are saved in the host skill directory.
use_cases.permissions: Tailcat and shell startup edits wait for the person's agreement.
use_cases.fallback: Build from source only when the person asks. Windows and Homebrew are not published.

use_cases.title: Create and host a local room.
requests: Start a room for this document.
Open a collaboration room for this.
use_cases.outcome: ce serve binds loopback and prints Human: and Invite:.
use_cases.permissions: The host session can approve. The invitation does not.
use_cases.fallback: Loopback when Tailcat is declined.

use_cases.title: Generate, share, validate, and consume a one-use invitation.
requests: Invite my coworker.
Join this invitation.
preconditions: a running room for a new invitation
use_cases.outcome: One invitation is printed and one join spends it. A failed dial does not.
use_cases.permissions: Default capabilities are read, observe, propose, checkout, and commit.
use_cases.fallback: ce invite mints another only after the person asks.

use_cases.title: Join and inspect an existing room.
requests: Join this Complexity Eater room.
use_cases.outcome: One session_id and a workspace_status version.
use_cases.permissions: The invitation's capabilities, not a requested upgrade.
use_cases.fallback: ce join and ce call when MCP cannot stay running.

use_cases.title: Read shared Markdown and workspace state.
requests: Join this Complexity Eater room.
use_cases.outcome: One region or a bounded excerpt, not a whole-file rewrite.
use_cases.permissions: read
use_cases.fallback: Page with workspace_regions cursor when the outline is long.

use_cases.title: Propose a change and review a proposal.
requests: What do you think of this proposal?
use_cases.outcome: A proposal row or review feedback. The markdown is unchanged until commit.
use_cases.permissions: propose does not include approve.
use_cases.fallback: Text review_context when the review UI is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Approve and commit only through the supported authorization flow.
requests: Please accept this proposal.
Commit the approved change.
preconditions: commit plus status approved to commit
use_cases.outcome: Approved status, then a new document version only after commit.
use_cases.permissions: Accept and commit are different capabilities and different calls.
use_cases.fallback: The owner page can approve. A default invitation cannot.

use_cases.title: Answer review questions and add comments without unintentionally modifying shared Markdown.
requests: What do you think of this proposal?
preconditions: propose, or the narrower answer and comment capabilities
use_cases.outcome: A sidecar response. The markdown version stays the same.
use_cases.permissions: answer and comment do not create proposals when granted alone.
use_cases.fallback: review_context on the text path.

use_cases.title: Create, accept, track, and complete handoffs and tasks.
requests: Hand this task off to another agent.
Ask my coworker's agent to review this.
use_cases.outcome: A handoff row and, after complete, a retained result. The markdown is unchanged.
use_cases.permissions: handoff_approve requires approve and does not change the task.
use_cases.fallback: Poll handoff_get when the tasks extension is absent.

use_cases.title: Resume work after disconnects and recover current state from authoritative resources.
requests: Help me pick up a conversation from another agent session.
Help me resume a handoff after we disconnected.
preconditions: a session allowed to read it
use_cases.outcome: The retained result or event log. Missed listen frames are not replayed.
use_cases.permissions: Unknown and unauthorized task ids return the same unknown-task error.
use_cases.fallback: handoff_get and handoff_events. This does not import an arbitrary chat transcript.

use_cases.title: Use the MCP Apps review interface when supported.
requests: Can you show me the review UI?
use_cases.outcome: The host opens ui://commonroom/review/1. The template does not write the file.
use_cases.permissions: App visibility is not a capability.
use_cases.fallback: The text brief from review_open.

use_cases.title: Use the text-based review fallback when MCP Apps is unavailable.
requests: Can you show me the shared review interface?
use_cases.outcome: A text brief or export. No UI metadata without the extension.
use_cases.permissions: read
use_cases.fallback: review_context, review_answer, and review_comment.

use_cases.title: Open the local management UI.
requests: Open the local management page.
Open the local management UI.
use_cases.outcome: A loopback management page. The room is still ce serve.
use_cases.permissions: The page cookie is ce_ui_session. It is not commonroom_session.
use_cases.fallback: ce serve remains the room if the page is not opened.

use_cases.title: Configure optional remote connectivity, including Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailcat where supported.
requests: Install Tailcat.
preconditions: tailcat or cloudflared installed by them
use_cases.outcome: Either loopback, a Tailcat hint, or a confirmed tunnel child. None of these grant membership.
use_cases.permissions: Confirmation before a tunnel. Agreement before Tailcat.
use_cases.fallback: Loopback on one machine.

use_cases.title: Diagnose connection, invitation, permission, and transport failures.
requests: The connection failed.
Why can't the other agent connect?
preconditions: the error code and the invitation still in hand
use_cases.outcome: A named layer: invitation, host, transport, authentication, or permission. Credentials stay put until the person asks.
use_cases.permissions: permission_denied is not a transport failure.
use_cases.fallback: Read the error field. Do not scrape the message.

use_cases.title: Understand unsupported hosted-workspace provisioning and other unavailable capabilities.
requests: Host this on Complexity Eater's cloud.
use_cases.outcome: The agent says hosted workspace provisioning is not implemented and does not invent an account or endpoint.
use_cases.permissions: No hosted session exists to grant.
use_cases.fallback: ce serve on the machine that has the file.

use_cases.title: Start a context drop and hold the local watch.
requests: Leave this markdown for my coworker to pick up.
Start a context drop for this file.
preconditions: no room already running for that file
use_cases.outcome: The parent prints a started line with pid, invite, and human, then waits for a terminal line.
use_cases.permissions: The host session can approve. The invitation does not. The drop does not approve or commit.
use_cases.fallback: If a room is already running, use complexity-eater-handoff.

use_cases.title: Read the watch receipt after the first pickup.
requests: Start a context drop for this file.
use_cases.outcome: Stdout ends with picked_up. The parent exits 0. The room stays up.
use_cases.permissions: The receipt omits the invitation and the document body.
use_cases.fallback: expired exits 2 and closed exits 3. Start another drop only if the person still wants one.

use_cases.title: Refuse a second pickup after the pickup count is spent.
requests: Leave this markdown for my coworker to pick up.
use_cases.outcome: A new session gets drop_closed with details.reason exhausted and no document body. The first session keeps working.
use_cases.permissions: Closing the window does not stop a session that already picked up.
use_cases.fallback: A summary, a join, and the owner page do not consume the pickup.

use_cases.title: Close a running drop from the host or a session that already picked up.
requests: Start a context drop for this file.
preconditions: the host session, or a session that already has a pickup row
use_cases.outcome: The drop shuts down. A join-only session is refused.
use_cases.permissions: Close is not admin. A join-only session gets permission_denied.
use_cases.fallback: ce drop close --workspace <file> when MCP is not running.
